fields.description: Let whoever receives goods put them straight onto a location. Switch this off and arriving stock always lands in unassigned stock, for the location manager to distribute afterwards from the board.

fields.description: Only these warehouses (and their children) are used by Isoft Location Manager. Leave empty to enable all. Locations cannot be set on a Stock Entry for a warehouse that is not enabled.
fields.label: Enabled Warehouses
Access
fields.options:
Who can open this app is the Location Manager role, assigned on the User like any other role. Everyone else keeps working normally: locations still appear, and can still be chosen, on the documents they already use.
What a manager sees is their ERPNext User Permissions for Warehouse, narrowed to the warehouses enabled below. A user with no warehouse permission sees every enabled warehouse.
